task.description: Gate docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-003.md per WF-02 Step 3b. Read the spec independently. TEST-DESIGNER's handoff claims markup-exact assertions and the Node key-set/value-diff scripts were verified against a locally-booted npm run dev instance, and that a wrong assumption about /xx's 404 behavior was caught and corrected (it 307-redirects to /ru/xx first). Check the spec covers all 6 REQ-003 acceptance criteria (AC1-AC6, plus AC2b) with no TODO, and each case is precise enough to run without judgment (exact route/viewport/theme/expected result — not 'check it looks right').
acceptance_criteria: Every REQ-003 acceptance criterion has at least one verification case (a) targeting it
No TODO left in the spec (b)
Each case is precise enough to run without judgment — exact route, viewport, theme, expected result (c)

result.summary: Read docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-003.md independently (not TEST-DESIGNER's self-report). Coverage check: the spec's own coverage table maps every REQ-003 acceptance criterion (locales array, en.json key-set match, verbatim-value match except Metadata.ogLocale, /en <html lang> + /ru,/uz non-regression, LocaleSwitcher three options + bidirectional navigation + anchor preservation, npm run build cleanliness, /en no-missing-translation-key check) to at least one of AC1-AC6/AC2b -- no gap found. No-TODO check: grep for 'TODO' in the file returned zero matches. Precision check: every case names an exact route (or explicit N/A for non-page/script/build checks), exact viewport (600px/1024px or explicit N/A with a stated reason), theme (explicit N/A with the header's design-based justification, or light+dark for AC6's content-completeness check), and an exact expected result (literal strings, exit codes, byte-for-byte markup, script stdout) -- no 'check it looks right' language anywhere. Independently re-derived rather than trusting TEST-DESIGNER's claims: booted npm run dev myself and reproduced AC3's curl checks (/en -> '<html lang="en"', /ru -> '<html lang="ru"', /uz -> '<html lang="uz"', / -> 307 to /ru, /xx -> 307 to /ru/xx -> 404) all matching the spec exactly, including the corrected /xx assumption; reproduced AC4's exact .lang switcher markup on both /ru and /en via curl+grep, byte-for-byte identical to the spec's claimed strings; ran the AC2 key-set script and the AC2b value-diff script for real against messages/ru.json and messages/en.json, confirming ru_count=177/en_count=177 and diff_keys=["Metadata.ogLocale"] with en_ogLocale="en_US"/ru_ogLocale="ru_RU" exactly as the spec states. Dev server stopped after verification. All three gate checks (a/b/c) pass for every acceptance criterion.
